title: Seagrove Serenity Home | KEY.co
description_expanded: Bring your family and embark on an unforgettable vacation along the beautiful Emerald Coast. Discover our world-famous beaches and be mesmerized by the breathtaking waters. With a community pool at your disposal, you'll have plenty of opportunities to cool off and make lasting memories. Escape to this wonderful vacation home and experience the best that this coastal paradise has to offer. On the first floor, you'll find a delightful bedroom suite complete with a queen bed and a shared bathroom. Ascend to the second floor, where two more bedrooms await. The master suite is a tranquil haven, featuring a balcony where you can soak in the serenity of the area while listening to the soothing sounds of the ocean waves in the evenings. Step inside to discover the first floor, where an open-concept kitchen and living area await. This layout is ideal for entertaining, allowing you to effortlessly mingle with your loved ones. Additionally, a screened-in porch offers a cozy space to relax and enjoy the gentle breeze.

Features: We do not guarantee internet connectivity.
